LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedBark.label: gnawed bark
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedBark.description: Rough bark has cut the mouth and gut. It hurts, then heals on its own.
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedWall.label: gnawed wall
LanguageData.RHAH_GnawedWall.description: Wall grit has dulled the hunger and cut the mouth. Hunger slows, and the pain is worse. It heals on its own.
LanguageData.RHAH_OvergnawedWall.label: overgnawed wall
LanguageData.RHAH_OvergnawedWall.description: Too much wall grit has dulled consciousness and left almost no room in the stomach. The pain is severe.
